name: They Said So Quotes
tagline: Famous quotes API with categories, authors, and a daily quote endpoint.
description: They Said So provides a REST API for retrieving famous quotes by category, author, keyword, or as a quote of the day. Responses include quote text, author, tags, and metadata. Free and paid plans are offered; free access has strict daily request caps suitable for light demos and learning projects.

auth.details: API key via Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY header (or X-TheySaidSo-Api-Secret for some clients); free tier may work without a key with tighter limits. Self-serve signup on theysaidso.com.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Public endpoints: 10 calls/hour without authentication; higher limits require a paid plan.
pricing.paid_plans: Premium $9.99/mo (2,500 calls/day), Ultra $24.99/mo (8,000/day), Enterprise $74.99/mo (unlimited). Confirm on pricing page before publish.

rate_limits: Free unauthenticated ~10 req/hour; higher on free key and paid plans (see pricing)
use_cases: get the quote of the day
fetch quotes by category or keyword
look up quotes by a specific author
populate an inspiration or education feature with curated quotes
